theses.longform: Most AI coding assistant pilots don't fail on model quality; they stall around day 90 because the organisation measured seat activation instead of changed work, so the renewal decision arrives with no evidence either way.
theses.linkedin: AI coding assistant pilots stall around day 90 because teams measure seat activation instead of changed work, so the renewal decision arrives with no evidence either way.
theses.newsletter: AI coding assistant pilots stall at renewal because nobody agreed in week one what changed work to measure, so the fix is a one-meeting measurement plan with an owner and a baseline.
theses.proof-points: AI coding assistant pilots stall around day 90 because organisations measure seat activation instead of changed work, leaving no evidence at the renewal decision.
theses.talk: Coding assistant pilots stall around day 90 because teams count seat activation instead of changed work, so the fix is one agreed measure with a named owner from week one.
